title: The predicate is inside the query, a refusal is indistinguishable from absence, and no restricted content leaks
mechanism: the predicate is a where-clause fragment, never a post-filter; every surface returns one refusal value

cases.what: a page is full when the filtered set has more rows, so the filter runs before the limit
a restricted row is removed by the query, not by the caller
the cursor is derived from the filtered set and never repeats a row
a missing post and an unauthorized post are the same answer
a shared link cannot distinguish 'does not exist' from 'not available to you', and carries no bytes
an unpublished link is the same answer as a missing one
liking an invisible post is 404 and writes nothing
unliking after losing access returns like_count null and no other field
the SQL fragment interpolates no value and is a boolean expression over the post alias
media is authorized through the attached post, and narrowing the audience revokes access on the next request
an unattached asset is readable by its owner only
the liker list omits blocked likers and carries no age or gender field

limitations: The media resolver's room-poster branch matches the layout JSON's poster list; it is exercised only by construction, not by a test with a real room layout.
